assertions.quoted_span: • zona cuscinetto di 2,5 km di raggio attorno alle zone infette.
assertions.claim: The sibling-mint remediation assigns this 2.5 km eradication buffer to B-PAR-DM2022-6.7-post-m5-inward-band-5km, a 5 km inward containment-surveillance parameter; the same decimal-substring collision affects 22 dispositions and violates branch and geometry grain.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Require bounded numeric-phrase matching plus semantic compatibility of purpose and branch, then point each act expression to the applicable 2.5 km eradication-buffer mint rather than the 5 km containment-surveillance mint.
assertions.falsifier: B-PAR-DM2022-6.7-post-m5-inward-band-5km is shown to represent the 2.5 km eradication buffer stated by this act.

assertions.quoted_span: L’area delimitata è costituita da una zona infetta (zona di almeno 50 m di raggio attorno alla pianta infetta) e da una zona cuscinetto (2,5 km quando la zona infetta è stabilita ai fini dell’adozione di misure di eradicazione e almeno 5 km quando la zona infetta è stabilita ai fini dell’adozione di misure di contenimento).
assertions.claim: The entire three-geometry area-composition expression is recorded as restating B-PAR-DM2022-6.7-post-m5-inward-band-5km, although it independently states a 50 m infected-zone floor, a 2.5 km eradication buffer, and a 5 km outward containment buffer rather than an inward surveillance band.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Split the expression at the three independently variable geometry spans and link each span to the corresponding Article 4 parameter.
assertions.falsifier: The referenced inward-surveillance parameter is shown to carry all three area-composition geometries and their distinct branch meanings.

assertions.quoted_span:
In particolare, nelle aree in eradicazione, le attività di indagine del vettore saranno effettuate
  annualmente in tutta l'area delimitata
assertions.claim: The expression is recorded as implementing B-CLK-IT-27(3)-annual-regional-proposal merely because both contain “annualmente”, but it states an independent annual recurrence for vector investigations across the demarcated area and no current clock carries that fact.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Mint a recurrence clock for the plan's annual vector investigations, with the §9.3 surveillance decision as consumer, rather than linking the expression to the annual national-survey proposal cycle.
assertions.falsifier: An existing clock is identified whose scope and completion already carry annual vector investigations throughout the demarcated area under §9.3.

assertions.quoted_span: La scheda di indagine viene approva dal Comitato Fitosanitario Nazionale (CFN) e revisionata periodicamente per gli aggiornamenti normativi, distribuzione geografica e procedure di indagine.
assertions.claim: The periodic revision of a CFN technical instruction is recorded as implementing B-CLK-IT-31(9)-periodic-area-surveys solely through the shared word “periodicamente”, although document revision and regional surveys are independent facts with different actors and effects.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Replace the sibling reference with an authored vested-elsewhere disposition for CFN document revision and require semantic actor, object, and effect agreement before accepting a sibling mint.
assertions.falsifier: The CFN's revision of the technical instruction is shown to be the same legal act as the Regional Plant Health Service's periodic survey of a demarcated area.

assertions.quoted_span: Member States shall immediately notify the Commission and the other Member States of measures taken by them in accordance with paragraph 1.
assertions.claim: The notification of an Article 31(1) more-stringent national measure is recorded as implementing B-CLK-EU-5(2)-notify-reduction, which instead concerns notification of the justification for reducing a Xylella buffer zone; shared notification wording does not make these the same fact.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Restore the vested-elsewhere national-actor disposition for the Article 31 notification and reject sibling matches whose referenced provision concerns a different underlying measure.
assertions.falsifier: Article 31(1)'s more-stringent national measure is shown to be the same decision as an Article 5(1) Xylella buffer-zone reduction.

assertions.quoted_span: 1. Chiunque venga a conoscenza della presenza dell’organismo specificato ne informa immediatamente il Servizio fitosanitario regionale e fornisce tutte le informazioni pertinenti.
assertions.claim: A third party's immediate report to the Regional Plant Health Service is recorded as implementing B-CLK-LR4-2(4)-inform-controllers, although Article 2(4) is the service's opposite-direction duty to inform controllers and the Article 2(1) awareness anchor is not holdable without fabrication.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Restore the fact-not-holdable disposition for the third party's awareness-anchored duty and require actor and communication-direction agreement before linking a sibling clock.
assertions.falsifier: Articles 2(1) and 2(4) are shown to impose the same communication, on the same actor, toward the same recipient.

assertions.quoted_span:
ai proprietari/conduttori di vigneti,
      compresi nei provvedimenti ingiuntivi dell’Osservatorio Fitosanitario, è consentita l’estirpazione su
      base volontaria delle superfici vitate ricadenti entro i 400 metri dal perimetro della zona infetta
assertions.claim: The case-specific 400 m voluntary-vineyard surface is recorded as restating B-PAR-DGR1075-almond-band-400m, although the referenced parameter governs mandatory almond removal and the shared magnitude does not make the populations or decisions identical.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Replace the almond reference with the authored case-delta ground and require population, measure, and legal-basis compatibility for sibling parameters.
assertions.falsifier: The DGR 903 voluntary-vineyard rule applied by DDS 35 is shown to be the same legal parameter as DGR 1075's mandatory-almond removal band.

checked_sound: Confirmed the frozen canonical SHA-256 e1bc21e8c79b9ca48e956222dfc592bc87b68bf09d40bdfe372bca8fc5699afd and counts of 71 clocks, 53 parameters and 581 dispositions.

Exhaustively reviewed all 165 distinct non-null dispositions[].why values. No surviving exclusion rests on absence of a held case, non-exercise in practice, historical irrelevance, or non-acquisition; the DDS 148 reason now correctly states that its retained successor recital supplies no period, threshold or geometry and treats the unacquired body as an acquisition item rather than an exclusion ground.

Examined all 161 Stage A rows absent from the 362-row seams 1–3 population. The operative quantified deadlines outside the population remain in held seam 4, apart from IT-DM-169819-2022:Art.7(11):cessation-notice:v1, whose six-month duty is vested in a national reference laboratory toward the central service and INRPP.

Verified all 15 closed-interval disposition instances across eight pre-L.R. 45 rows. Each producer is SUPERSEDED with effective_to_exclusive 2021-12-18; no current producer is excluded as a closed interval.

Verified the Article 39 retraction against the verbatim source: “any time they consider that an audit is necessary” is a condition triggering an audit but states no period, deadline, ordering or promptness standard. Its removal loses no Stage B-computable fact; the open “on a regular basis” recurrence and immediate-withdrawal clock remain.

Verified removal of the per-row seam field loses no aperture membership: closure_manifest owns every minted clock and parameter membership, population.json owns all 362 population memberships, and no clock, parameter or disposition retains a seam key.

Verified the PNI correction: all five design targets and nine workload tuples plus the 1 km band have parameter dispositions, including separate occurrences for the prunus/citrus and vitis 0.95/0.0009 expressions; no stale Q8 exclusion remains.

Sampled every present seam/clock-kind combination and confirmed its source_phrase verbatim in its producer source_quote: seam 1 deadline, promptness_standard, recurrence and same_calendar_day; seam 2 deadline, eligibility_threshold, minimum_duration, ordering_constraint, promptness_standard and recurrence; seam 3 deadline, lookback_window, not_before, ordering_constraint, promptness_standard and recurrence.

Re-verified the principal pre-M5/post-M5 and branch pairs: Article 5(1)(c) keeps separate first-year, 2.5 km and 400 m facts with the 90 percent/1 percent design only in v2; Article 15 keeps separate pre-M5 5 km and post-M5 2 km inward containment bands; Article 4 keeps distinct 2.5 km eradication and 5 km containment buffer floors.

Confirmed every disposition ref resolves to an existing mint and the three byte-identical disposition duplicates removed after cycle 3 have not returned; these integrity checks do not cure the semantic misreferences asserted above.
